BoreDM (https://boredm.com) | Software Engineer | Boston, MA or Washington, D.C. | Full-time | $90k-$150K+

We’re building the modern standard for subsurface data management. Our software handles borehole logging, lab testing, CPT data, and PDF digitization. BoreDM is used by 40+ geotechnical firms and 20+ state DOTs nationwide.

Looking for a full-stack engineer to join us. Interest or experience in local-first/offline-first architecture is a plus.

Stack: TypeScript, React, Python, Flask, Jazz.tools, SST, AWS

Boston preferred, but D.C. works too.
